# aikido_users (Data Source)

Looks up users in the Aikido workspace. Returns every user, active and inactive, unless filters narrow the result. Filters combine with AND; a filter that matches nothing yields an empty list rather than an error. No filter is guaranteed to identify exactly one account, not even email, so ids may hold zero or several entries: use one(...) where a single user is required and the configuration should fail otherwise. The underlying endpoint returns the whole workspace in a single unpaginated response.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Looking a user up by email is the usual way to turn a person into the numeric
# ID the membership resources need. Matching ignores case.
data "aikido_users" "alice" {
  email = "alice@example.com"
}

output "alice_user_id" {
  # one(...) fails the plan if the lookup matched no user, or more than one,
  # rather than silently picking an account.
  value = one(data.aikido_users.alice.ids)
}

# Filters combine with AND. Omitting every filter returns the whole workspace,
# deactivated users included.
data "aikido_users" "active_admins" {
  role   = "admin"
  active = true
}

output "active_admin_emails" {
  value = [for user in data.aikido_users.active_admins.users : user.email]
}

# Selecting by anything the filters do not cover is a Terraform expression over
# the users list: an email domain, a name prefix, a login recency check.
data "aikido_users" "all" {}

output "contractor_user_ids" {
  description = "Users authenticating outside the company identity provider."
  value = [
    for user in data.aikido_users.all.users :
    user.id if user.auth_type != "saml" && user.active
  ]
}

output "never_logged_in" {
  description = "Users who have been invited but have never signed in."
  value = [
    for user in data.aikido_users.all.users :
    user.email if user.last_login_timestamp == 0
  ]
}
```

## Schema

### Optional

- `active` (Boolean) Only return users with this activation state. Omit to return both active and deactivated users.
- `auth_type` (String) Only return users authenticating this way: github, gitlab, bitbucket, google, office365 or saml.
- `email` (String) Only return users with exactly this email address, compared without regard to case.
- `full_name` (String) Only return users whose full name is exactly this.
- `id` (Number) Only return the user with this Aikido user ID.
- `role` (String) Only return users with this workspace role: admin, default or team_only.

### Read-Only

- `ids` (Set of Number) Numeric IDs of the matching users, typed to match the user_id attribute of the membership resources.
- `users` (Attributes List) The matching users, in ID order. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--users))

<a id="nestedatt--users"></a>
### Nested Schema for `users`

Read-Only:

- `active` (Boolean) Whether the user is active in the workspace.
- `auth_type` (String) How the user authenticates: github, gitlab, bitbucket, google, office365 or saml.
- `email` (String) Email address of the user.
- `full_name` (String) Full name of the user.
- `id` (Number) Aikido user ID.
- `last_login_timestamp` (Number) Unix timestamp of the user's last login.
- `role` (String) Workspace role of the user: admin, default or team_only.
